question: Jesus said if a sheep falls into a pit on the Sabbath, its owner will lift it out. What did he conclude from this?
options: Sheep should not be kept near pits
No work should be done at all on the Sabbath
Only priests may help on the Sabbath
A person is much more valuable than a sheep, so it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath
explanation: Matthew 12:12 says, "How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
